values.note: Effective April 1, 2025: Full Hook-up Site 30/50 amp $70/$75 for Montgomery County residents, $80/$85 for non-residents (the page does not label the two figures). Tent sites are $40/$45 (non-residents $45/$50); their gravel parking pads run 43-64 ft, but the pages do not say an RV may use one, so the base here is the full-hookup site.

fees.source: https://montgomeryparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-bennett-regional-park/little-bennett-campground/fees/ ('Effective April 1, 2025'; 'Full Hook-up Site 30/50 amp $70/$75'; Non-Residents 'Full Hook-up Site 30/50 amp $80/$85') + https://montgomeryparks.org/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/little-bennett-campground-site-specifications.pdf, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Active/retired military and seniors 60 and over get $3 off a campsite Sunday through Thursday.

discounts.source: https://montgomeryparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-bennett-regional-park/little-bennett-campground/fees/ ('Active/Retired Military Personnel and Seniors 60 and over receive a $3 discount for campsite rental from Sunday through Thursday.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations through ActiveMontgomery. After 14 nights a camper must leave for at least seven nights. Cancellations must be emailed; one made 3-13 days out is refunded less $25. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://montgomeryparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-bennett-regional-park/little-bennett-campground/fees/ ('Campsite Rentals 2 Night Minimum. Holiday Weekends 3 Night minimum.') + https://montgomeryparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-bennett-regional-park/little-bennett-campground/ ('Reservations through ActiveMontgomery'; 'A minimum of two-nights is required for all reservations. Campers may enjoy a maximum stay of 14 nights on all camping loops'; Cancellation Policy), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://montgomeryparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-bennett-regional-park/little-bennett-campground/ ('22 sites are available with full hook-ups (water/electric/sewer)') + https://montgomeryparks.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/montgomery-parks-little-bennett-campground-site-specifications.pdf (Loop D: every site 30/50 amps), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 91 campsites: 22 full-hookup sites in Loop D and 63 tent sites, plus 3 canvas tent sites, 3 cabins and 3 yurts. Loop D's two-vehicle gravel parking pads run 40-74 ft; four (D49, D51, D54, D55) are pull-through, and the operator marks most as a best option for Class A or fifth-wheel rigs. No maximum rig length is published.

sites.source: https://montgomeryparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-bennett-regional-park/little-bennett-campground/ ('91 wooded campsites'; 'Each of the 63 tent sites have a tent pad. 22 sites are available with full hook-ups') + https://montgomeryparks.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/montgomery-parks-little-bennett-campground-site-specifications.pdf (Parking Pad Length, Pull-Thru), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bathhouses are closed November until April; portable toilets near Loop D then.

facilities.source: https://montgomeryparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-bennett-regional-park/little-bennett-campground/ ('Bathhouses with sinks, showers, toilet facilities and drinking fountains'; 'Water spigots are randomly located throughout each camping loop'; Camp Store Hours; '**Bathhouses are closed November until April'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: In season March through November; 'December to February Campground is closed.'

season.source: https://montgomeryparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-bennett-regional-park/little-bennett-campground/ ('March through November** (In-Season)'; Camp Store Hours: 'December to February Campground is closed. Reservation office will remain open for future bookings.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Montgomery County / M-NCPPC (Little Bennett Regional Park), Clarksburg MD - the county's only public campground. Full hookups are in Loop D; the other loops are tent sites, besides canvas tents, yurts and cabins. Campground loops sit on wooded uplands, not on the water. --Claude
